name: Chishima Mako
source:
A small girl Oka met one day on the train.

She wants to spoil him. She wants him to let himself be spoiled. She wants to act older than she is.

She has a bright and positive personality, and always wants to be of use to someone. She likes lonely people like her.

Her shoe size is 21, meaning her age is around 10 or 11 years.

She lives practically alone, her relatives do not pay attention to her. She feels identified with Oka since she sees in him the same loneliness that she lives, which makes her want to be with him.

[spoiler]She really likes to be creampied by Oka.[/spoiler]
